entries.text: The body of a young woman was found two days ago. This morning another girl has disappeared.
entries.raw_text: 1,The body of a young woman was found two days ago. This morning another girl has disappeared.

entries.text: The councilor for the district has been filching from the coffers for years.
entries.raw_text: 1,The councilor for the district has been filching from the coffers for years.

entries.text: It is believed that the oldest building in the district has access to forgotten ruins and treasure.
entries.raw_text: 1,It is believed that the oldest building in the district has access to forgotten ruins and treasure.

entries.text: Every full moon the spirit of a man who was hung for a crime he didn’t commit returns to consume the life energy of those he comes across.
entries.raw_text: 1,Every full moon the spirit of a man who was hung for a crime he didn’t commit returns to consume the life energy of those he comes across.

entries.text: It is said that the museum houses an artifact that holds the bones of a long dead demigod.
entries.raw_text: 1,It is said that the museum houses an artifact that holds the bones of a long dead demigod.

entries.text: The magistrate is looking for a few brave souls to venture into the sewers and track a strange monster that has been attacking and eating people.
entries.raw_text: 1,The magistrate is looking for a few brave souls to venture into the sewers and track a strange monster that has been attacking and eating people.

entries.text: It is said that a prophet that a renowned prophet is in the district and in hiding after foretelling the death of a king.
entries.raw_text: 1,It is said that a prophet that a renowned prophet is in the district and in hiding after foretelling the death of a king.

entries.text: A strange smell is coming from the mansion on the hill, but everyone, even the City Watch is afraid to investigate.
entries.raw_text: 1,A strange smell is coming from the mansion on the hill, but everyone, even the City Watch is afraid to investigate.

entries.text: It is believed that if you stand beneath the statue of the weeping woman on a certain night at a certain time, her tears will fall and heal all your ailments.
entries.raw_text: 1,It is believed that if you stand beneath the statue of the weeping woman on a certain night at a certain time, her tears will fall and heal all your ailments.

entries.text: It is rumored that old Batty Ann was actually a princess who was exiled from her realm by her father.
entries.raw_text: 1,It is rumored that old Batty Ann was actually a princess who was exiled from her realm by her father.

entries.text: A man simply known as the “Flesher” has been prowling the streets at night and attacks people and harvests their organs for some diabolical purpose.
entries.raw_text: 1,A man simply known as the “Flesher” has been prowling the streets at night and attacks people and harvests their organs for some diabolical purpose.

entries.text: It is said that the temple of a forbidden and dark god resides in the cellar of one of the more prominent and respected chapels of the city.
entries.raw_text: 1,It is said that the temple of a forbidden and dark god resides in the cellar of one of the more prominent and respected chapels of the city.

entries.text: For some reason, for the last 5 years everyone in the district begins screaming at 2:30am for one minute and then falls silent.
entries.raw_text: 1,For some reason, for the last 5 years everyone in the district begins screaming at 2:30am for one minute and then falls silent.

entries.text: Molly, who owns the Hangman’s pub just outside the gallows, is believed to be a very successful smuggler who can’t be tried for her crimes due to a failed execution attempt on her when she was a young girl.
entries.raw_text: 1,Molly, who owns the Hangman’s pub just outside the gallows, is believed to be a very successful smuggler who can’t be tried for her crimes due to a failed execution attempt on her when she was a young girl.

entries.text: A strange new religious sect has moved into the district. They all wear black Niqabs from head to foot.  The priests wear blood read Niqabs.  No one has ever seen their faces.  However a faint hissing has been heard when near them.
entries.raw_text: 1,A strange new religious sect has moved into the district. They all wear black Niqabs from head to foot.  The priests wear blood read Niqabs.  No one has ever seen their faces.  However a faint hissing has been heard when near them.

entries.text: Whispers of plans to assassinate the despot king linger in the street. The level of tension is palpable.
entries.raw_text: 1,Whispers of plans to assassinate the despot king linger in the street. The level of tension is palpable.

entries.text: A strange mist appears every night.  People have heard an unearthly music and tinkling laughter in it.
entries.raw_text: 1,A strange mist appears every night.  People have heard an unearthly music and tinkling laughter in it.

entries.text: The magistrate is going to hold a tournament to find a new Knight Commander after the passing of the previous.  Tests will include feats of bravery, command, and martial prowess.
entries.raw_text: 1,The magistrate is going to hold a tournament to find a new Knight Commander after the passing of the previous.  Tests will include feats of bravery, command, and martial prowess.

entries.text: A powerful Madame is looking to hire people to find out who has been beating up and extorting her girls and clients.
entries.raw_text: 1,A powerful Madame is looking to hire people to find out who has been beating up and extorting her girls and clients.

entries.text: The Thieves Guild is believed to be actively recruiting after losing many of its novice members after an unsuccessful venture.
entries.raw_text: 1,The Thieves Guild is believed to be actively recruiting after losing many of its novice members after an unsuccessful venture.
